claims.text: The $6.00 fee fails the waiting-period test on the driver's own trace. The longest continuous run of qualifying in-geofence fixes at the Changi T1 pin is 255 seconds (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec, EV-GPS-00210), against the 480-second minimum the fee schedule sets for AIRPORT. That is 225 seconds short, and POL-NS-06 makes the shortfall decisive: the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. I disclose that EV-GPS-00210 is impaired - weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD - but the shortfall does not rest on the trace's broken parts: the admissibility pre-pass's own face-value reading of the same trace (first qualifying fix 23:42:21 to the 23:49:05 cancellation) is 404 seconds, still 76 seconds short. On every reading the required dwell was never reached.

The shortfall is independent of the trace. EV-TRIP-00210, the platform's own record, states wait_time_min of 6.9 - 414 seconds - against the 8-minute (480-second) AIRPORT minimum, and its arrived_at of 23:42:10 against its cancelled_at of 23:49:05 spans only 415 seconds. On the platform's most generous own numbers the driver terminated roughly 65 seconds before the mandatory dwell expired, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is not met and nothing is chargeable under POL-NS-06. The driver's account that he waited 'more than eight minutes' is contradicted by his own trip record. I disclose that EV-TRIP-00210 is impaired - weight 0.40, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT - but the 6.9-minute wait is the record's own figure and does not depend on the trace it conflicts with.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails on its own timing conjunct as well. The limb requires the trip to be terminated 'at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed', and limb (c) fixes the start of that dwell at the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not at the arrived tap. The first qualifying in-geofence fix on the trace is 23:42:21 and the trip was cancelled at 23:49:05, 404 seconds later - the driver pulled the plug 76 seconds before the 480th second. A cancellation that precedes the elapse of the required dwell cannot satisfy a limb written to require the opposite.

No time can be added to that dwell. POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road. The advisory artifact for this trip, EV-ADVIS-00210-01, is MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0 - so limb (i) is unavailable, no advisory can extend the driver's clock, and the derived facts record no second in-geofence interval to add in any event. The absence of any advisory covering the Changi T1 arrival kerb is itself citable, and it works against this charge rather than rescuing it.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is not made out either. It requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence 'at or before' the arrived event, and the earliest qualifying in-geofence fix on the trace is 23:42:21, which post-dates the trip record's 23:42:10 marker; the trace jumps from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21, so the 186-second gap swallows the moment of entry and no fix sits at the marker at all. The only route to limb (b) is to repair the timestamps using the 228-second device clock skew, and POL-NS-08(a) treats a skew over 90 seconds as an unsafe match between the arrived event and a GPS fix. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the party seeking the fee must carry every limb, so an unprovable limb (b) is a broken limb (b).

If the panel cannot close on a full refund because the two sources contradict each other, the case still cannot close as a charge against the rider. The trace is impaired under POL-NS-08(b) - a 186-second gap straddling entry, fewer than six fixes across the waiting window, and rider_track omitted - and under POL-NS-08(a) on the 228-second clock skew; the chat log is impaired under POL-NS-08(c), carrying 2 of the 4 messages the trip record records for the 23:42-23:49 window (weight 0.60, TRUNCATED_LOG). The deciding fact is therefore carried only by artifacts of weight 0.25 and 0.40, so under POL-GEN-02 rule (2) confidence cannot exceed 0.40, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-NS-09 limbs (a), (b) and (e) all engage. Escalation holds the fee rather than collecting it - EV-FARE-00210 shows payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 - so on that footing too the rider does not carry the disputed charge.

claims.text: Fare integrity is not in issue, and the charge as itemised is correct. Under the fee schedule's resolution rule the chargeable cancellation fee is the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee: AIRPORT is SGD 6.00 and RYDE_X is SGD 4.00, and the greater is exactly the SGD 6.00 itemised in fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee. POL-NS-08(d) is therefore not engaged, and EV-FARE-00210 — COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — reconciles precisely with this trip's zone class and vehicle tier.

The driver reached the pickup geofence. EV-GPS-00210's derived driver_track puts his nearest approach at 96.01 m from the pickup pin at Changi Terminal 1 — inside the 150 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for the AIRPORT zone class — and the derived arrival block records 5 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes against the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires. I disclose that EV-GPS-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 on CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD; the proximity and fix-count findings survive the discount because clock skew and truncation displace timestamps, not measured distances between fixes and the pin.

POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied, or at worst undecidable — it is not affirmatively failed. The record's arrived event is 23:42:10 and the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21, an eleven-second offset. EV-GPS-00210's own admissibility report measures a device clock skew of 228 seconds, twenty times that offset, so eleven seconds cannot establish that the driver was outside the geofence when he marked arrival. Read with the skew correction the same fix maps to 23:38:33 server time, some three and a half minutes before the marker. I rely on derived.arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec, which is precisely the field the skew contaminates, and I disclose that both artifacts are impaired: EV-TRIP-00210 at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT and EV-GPS-00210 at weight 0.25 on the six codes set out above.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied and the rider does not contest it: the trip carries no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are null, and the driver terminated it with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) was deliberately drafted to recognise. The rider's claim text attacks the driver's presence and the arrival radius, not the termination code. EV-TRIP-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, which I disclose.

The rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall case cannot be run on this trace, so no shortfall is established. EV-GPS-00210 covers 22.8% of the active window, holds a 186-second sampling gap sitting directly across the moment of geofence entry (23:39:15 to 23:42:21), and stops at 23:46:36 — 149 seconds before the cancellation at 23:49:05, over the 120-second truncation tolerance. Any dwell figure read off it is a floor rather than a measurement, and POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-08(b) say expressly that fixes too sparse to carry the test are impairment, not proof of absence. The artifact is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 on CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

The trip record's own wait_time_min of 6.9 does not establish a shortfall either. That figure is arrived_at 23:42:10 to cancelled_at 23:49:05, and arrived_at is the very event the trace contradicts; the artifact is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 on CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT for exactly that reason. I do not ask the bench to convert the driver's own 'more than eight minutes' into 480 seconds on his say-so — I ask only that a number resting on a contested timestamp be given no weight in either direction.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04, which requires all three of its limbs. Limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window; the only rider message on the export is MSG-00210-004 at 23:49:40, thirty-five seconds after the driver terminated the trip at 23:49:05. Limb (c) cannot be satisfied at all: EV-GPS-00210 carries no rider_track, so the presence test is undecidable, and POL-NS-04's own text makes an undecidable limb (c) neutral — neutral is not satisfied, and a clause requiring all three limbs exonerates nobody on two. EV-CHAT-00210 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 on TRUNCATED_LOG, messages 002 and 003 being absent from the 23:42 to 23:49 window, so the export is not a complete picture; but it is the only chat evidence in the bundle, and on it limb (a) is not made out.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the absolute threshold of 4, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 156 is 0.013, far below the rate threshold of 0.08; the clause requires both limbs. Nothing in the profile therefore withholds the driver's compensation, which on a SGD 6.00 itemised fee is 80 percent, or SGD 4.80. These are two of the nine profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits as a ground of decision, and they are cited only for the test POL-NS-07 names.

EV-TRIP-00210 and EV-GPS-00210 are two admissible artifacts that contradict each other directly on arrival and on dwell — 23:42:10 with a 6.9-minute wait on one side, a first qualifying in-geofence fix at 23:42:21 with a 255-second qualifying run and 22.8% coverage on the other — and no clause in this policy resolves which is right. The sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) and (b), which on that clause's own terms caps the ruling and sends the case to a reviewer under POL-NS-09. Escalation holds the SGD 6.00 fee on its present PENDING status rather than refunding it, which is the disposition the evidence actually supports.

No traffic advisory covers the Changi Terminal 1 arrival kerb in this window. EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING, keeps its identifier and carries weight 0.0, and the absence is itself citable. It means the record discloses no kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident on the pickup road — nothing on the ground that would explain a driver unable to hold at the pin, and nothing that displaces the driver's account of waiting at Door 6.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this case cannot be decided on the evidence, so it goes to a human reviewer. The SGD 6.00 no-show fee stays on hold — it is not taken from the rider and not refunded to her — until that review is finished. Nothing is paid out today.

What the case turns on. A no-show fee stands only if the driver completed the full required hold at the pickup point — 480 seconds (8 minutes) for an airport kerb such as Changi T1 Door 6 — measured from the first GPS fix inside the pickup zone, not from the arrival tap. Two records speak to that and they contradict each other. The trip record puts the arrival marker at 23:42:10 and the hold at 6.9 minutes (415 seconds), already short of 480. The GPS trace's first qualifying fix inside the zone is 23:42:21 and its longest unbroken run of qualifying in-zone fixes is 255 seconds — also short — but the driver's device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server clock, and applying that correction puts the same entry at 23:38:33 and the hold at 632 seconds, comfortably over. A 186-second gap in the trace (23:39:15 to 23:42:21) sits exactly across the moment of entry and hides which reading is right.

Why this is an escalation and not a refund. POL-NS-08(a) makes a clock skew over 90 seconds an unsafe match between the arrival marker and any GPS fix, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is neither proved nor disproved. POL-NS-08(b) makes this trace's 186-second gap, sub-90% coverage and absent rider track fatal to any precise dwell figure, so limb (c), and limb (d) which depends on it, are undecided. The deciding facts therefore rest only on impaired artifacts: the GPS trace (weight 0.25 — CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD) and the trip record (weight 0.4 — CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT). The two records give conflicting values rather than the same fact, so the cap is the lower of them, 0.25, below the 0.70 floor — POL-NS-09(a). The two admissible records also contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell with no clause able to settle which is right — POL-NS-09(b). And the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b) — POL-NS-09(e).

On the individual points. Driver: your proximity argument (nearest approach 96 m, five qualifying in-zone fixes) is read off the same broken trace; it shows you were in the vicinity but cannot fix the entry moment that limb (b) actually reads. I accept that no boarding occurred and that the trip was closed with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, but limb (d) also requires the cancellation to fall at or after the elapse of the required hold, which is the very thing left undecided. Your profile shows 2 no-show terminations in 30 days against the threshold of 4 and a rate of 0.013 against 0.08, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip and nothing withholds your pay — but the 80% compensation (SGD 4.80) cannot be awarded while the hold that earns it is unproved. Rider: I have not found that you were at Door 6; your account is an account, not a measurement, and the trace carries no rider track to test your presence. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: your only message on the export is timed 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, so limb (a) is not met, and with no rider track limb (c) is undecidable — 'undecidable' is not 'satisfied'. Your shortfall case is also not established: the 255-second run and the face-value 404-second span to cancellation are both short of 480, but they come from the impaired trace, and the skew-corrected reading is over. The trip record's own 6.9 minutes likewise falls short of 480 seconds, but it runs from the contested arrival marker and is a competing account, not an independent measurement. No traffic advisory covers this kerb (EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so no interval can be summed to extend the hold; its absence decides nothing in either direction. The itemised charge itself is correctly computed — the greater of the AIRPORT zone fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (SGD 4.00) — so there is no fare-integrity defect, and no clause here produces a referral (POL-NS-05(ii) is not triggered, because qualifying in-zone fixes do exist).

What the reviewer must settle. Determine the true in-geofence entry time — in particular whether the 228-second device clock skew should be applied — and therefore whether the driver held at Door 6 for the full 480 seconds. If the hold is verified the fee stands and the driver is paid 80% of it (SGD 4.80); if it is not, the fee is refunded in full to the rider with no driver compensation.

Four claims were discarded at the citation stage, two from each side; the audit record accompanies this ruling.
